Privacy.metaDescription: What the Pact application asks for, why it is used, and how to ask for a correction or deletion.
Privacy.title: Privacy notice
Privacy.intro: This notice explains what the application to join the Pact for the Development of the Aerospace Sector in the State of Puebla asks for, and why.
Privacy.responsible: Clúster de Startups e Innovación, A.C., in Heroica Puebla de Zaragoza, Puebla, Mexico, is responsible. For any question about this data, write to secretariado@clusterdestartups.org.
Privacy.data: The adhesion form asks for the name of the organization, agency, company, or initiative; the type of organization; the name of the representative with legal authority; a contact email; a contact phone; why you want to join the Pact; what you bring to the aerospace ecosystem; what commitments you intend to take on; and your acceptance of this notice.
Privacy.purpose: The Clúster de Startups e Innovación uses this data to follow up on the adhesion request, including a call or a message to the contact phone, ahead of the letter and the November 30, 2026 signing. The contact email receives an automatic reply with the letter instructions and a draft built from what you wrote: organization, type, representative, reason, contribution, and commitments. The phone number is not included in that reply. The data is not used for advertising and is not shared with third parties for other purposes.
Privacy.delivery: The site does not keep its own database. When you send the form, FormSubmit (formsubmit.co) emails it to secretariado@clusterdestartups.org and sends the automatic reply to the contact email. FormSubmit handles the data only to make that delivery.
Privacy.rights: You can ask to access, correct, or delete your data, or object to its use, by writing to secretariado@clusterdestartups.org. The checkbox on the adhesion form is your consent to this notice.
